header.description: What: Demo-city, a long-range shoot and scoot down the clear east avenue (x 310-355): a Bradley ("IFV", 332,30, BasicVehicleSop) holds the avenue's south end (no cover there); two hostile technicals on LandPlatformAttack hide behind the houses at its north end, ~610-640 m away, out of its sight: "ATGM Technical" (291,650, a Kornet) and "HMG Technical" (289,664), both behind the house at 296,638 (the one building at a clear avenue's north end with a view down it). Each edges into the avenue, fires and scoots back. At ~620 m sighting takes seconds (CE-3260: ~2.7 s for a fully exposed IFV, ~4 s for a technical showing a third of itself) and the guns spread (R-2086), so the exchange runs over several exposures. Re-authored 2026-11-10 (R-2086, user: "Longer distance") from test-town's 160 m corner duel, which the first to see won in one shot. Judge: (1) the ATGM technical fires (2) the HMG technical fires (3) the IFV's first round goes at the ATGM technical (the danger to its armour). Fail: a technical never fires, or the IFV first fires at the HMG technical. Check: --verify ua-technical-scoot
